# [pytorch compile] Incorrect result when `compile` changes

<!-- DRAFT generated by tcc. Review every section before filing (plan 18.6). -->

## Summary
The compiled execution is inconsistent with Python eager execution when `compile` changes from `{'dynamic': True}` to `(base)`.
all pre-Inductor layers agree and only Inductor differs: lowering / code generation
This test was generated because the static analysis found: compile flag changes specialization (factor `compile.dynamic`, oracles ['value', 'metadata']).

## Environment
- Python: 3.14.7
- Framework: PyTorch 2.14.0+cpu
- Compiler backend: inductor
- Commit/version: 08187d9e0fba026dc8217405802ab5381dc88d90
- CUDA/ROCm: none (CPU)
- GPU: cpu
- OS: Windows 11
- Triton: None

## Minimal Reproducer

```python
import torch
torch.manual_seed(0)

def opinfo_var_mean(*args):
    return torch.var_mean(*args)

args = (torch.randn(0),)

eager = opinfo_var_mean(*args)
torch._dynamo.reset()
compiled = torch.compile(opinfo_var_mean, backend='inductor')(*args)
print('eager   :', eager)
print('compiled:', compiled)
```

## Expected Behavior

Eager/reference result:

```text
structure: P[T,T]
[0] [nan]
[1] [nan]
```

## Actual Behavior

Compiled result:

```text
structure: P[T,T]
[0] [nan]
[1] [0]
```

## Trigger Condition

Changed semantic factor:

```text
compile: {'dynamic': True} -> (base)
```

Controlled factors:

```text
shape / dtype / stride / device / compile flags: unchanged
```

Execution sequence:

```text
E0_eager: ok
E1_dynamo_eager: ok
E2_aot_eager: ok
E3_inductor: ok
```

## Difference

```text
E3_inductor:
  [value] output[1]: NaN/Inf present on one side only
      max absolute error        : 0.0
      mismatching elements      : 0
      total elements            : 1
```

## Suspected Stage

```text
TorchInductor (lowering / codegen)
```

Attribution basis: first divergent layer = E3_inductor; all pre-Inductor layers agree and only Inductor differs: lowering / code generation
